items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1959-08-11
items.q: When I worked at Tom Anderson, he played... He played trumpet in there

ctx.x: a... a... Yeah. Well, I've been trying to think for three days of a trumpet player. I told Ralph the other day, it begins with K. from uptown. It went through my head. Keelan. Frank Keelan?

Frank Keelan was a trumpet player. With this one of these old... You know, like you ever heard him, I guess you would call it a barrel house. You know. That's a barrel house. That's a barrel house. That's a barrel house. Yeah. Well, he didn't play in all these good time, big time bands, you know. But all those bands like we were like... I had one time when we was playing up at Tom Anderson. When I worked at Tom Anderson, he played... He played trumpet in there, because he... It was... He played soft trumpet, you…
